name: Tomomatsu Miki
source: A serious teacher who is strict with her students. Once confronting her former classmate Megumi of her affair, Miki questions herself if she should engage in an affair with someone younger like Megumi.
translation: A serious teacher who is strict with her students. Once confronting her former classmate Megumi of her affair, Miki questions herself if she should engage in an affair with someone younger like Megumi.
